title: Sauna House Durham

services.name: Dry sauna
services.desc: A Nordic spa centered on premium massage services and a traditional Thermal Cycle. Come reset your nervous system using the power of sauna and cold water therapy, and leave lighter, brighter, and inspired. Once home to the Borden Ice Cream Company, this historic building is full of character-from its 16-inch-thick insulated walls to towering ceilings and nine-foot-tall windows. Working alongside Redline Architects, Woody and the team designed the layout to celebrate the south-facing glass and flood the space with natural light, creating an inviting, welcoming atmosphere for the Greenville community.
